scenarios.role: read-only audit of boundedness, duplicate meaning, stale paths, public hygiene, and owner route
default_validation: targeted validator for the audited surface when one is named
scenarios.done_signal: audit findings are scoped, evidenced, and routed to the correct owner or validator
scenarios.stop_line: do not rewrite the audited surface during audit-only work

scenarios.role: one small source-backed patch to an existing technique bundle
default_validation: targeted owner-surface validator when one is named
scenarios.done_signal: one existing technique is more atomic, portable, sanitized, and reviewable
scenarios.stop_line: stop when the patch asks for a second owner, broader design, or non-technique object

scenarios.role: map donor, legacy, or mechanic-local material before deeper distillation
scenarios.done_signal: likely active homes, rejected material, portability concerns, and next owner route are named
scenarios.stop_line: do not perform deep semantic distillation or canon promotion inside scout mode

scenarios.role: review a concrete diff or PR for technique-canon risk and missed checks
scenarios.done_signal: findings are ordered by severity and tied to exact paths
scenarios.stop_line: do not rewrite the diff while acting as reviewer

scenarios.role: align docs, registry, validator, release gate, and generated companions
scenarios.done_signal: source, registry, docs, validator, and generated mirror agree
scenarios.stop_line: do not create a new source of truth while syncing derived routes

scenarios.role: add bounded tests for an already clear source contract
default_validation: targeted unittest discovery for the changed test directory
owning source-surface validator when one is named
scenarios.done_signal: tests prove a named existing contract and pass locally
scenarios.stop_line: do not invent new semantics to make tests interesting

scenarios.role: run a fast release-readiness pass without publishing
scenarios.done_signal: changed surfaces, checks, public-claim risks, generated parity, and owner routes are named
scenarios.stop_line: do not publish, tag, push, or merge without an explicit user command
